judged_text: Nothing ever resets the controller's usernames value — not after a successful add (the code carries a 'TODO: should clear the input') and not in setupController when switching groups — even though the admin-group controller is a singleton reused across every group. Usernames typed while viewing group A are still sitting in the input when the admin opens group B, so clicking Add on B submits A's leftover usernames to B's add_members endpoint and silently adds the wrong users to the wrong group; clicking Add twice on the same group also re-submits the same names.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `usernames` is now a plain controller property (`usernames: null`) bound to the `{{user-selector usernames=usernames}}` input in `admin/templates/group.hbs`. The new `addMembers` action explicitly notes `// TODO: should clear the input` and does not reset `this.usernames` after calling `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"))`. Also, `AdminGroupRoute.setupController` was changed to only `controller.set("model", model); model.findMembers();` and no longer sets/derives anything that would clear `usernames` when switching to a different group. Since Ember controllers are singletons by default, this means previously-entered usernames can persist across group navigation and be resubmitted (including on repeated clicks), matching the finding’s described behavior.
